title: CHILD DEVELOPMENT TEACHER
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Child Development Teacher Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Integrate an understanding of the needs, characteristics, and multiple influences that support optimal development in all areas of development for children from birth to age eight.
Promote partnerships between programs, teachers, families, and communities, applying ethical standards and culturally sensitive professional behavior.
Design, implement, and evaluate developmentally appropriate environments, curriculum and teacher/child interactions, while applying the skills of observation and assessment.
Apply effective guidance and interaction strategies that support a child’s social learning, identity, and self-confidence in an early childhood classroom setting.

notes: Read only the 'Child Development Teacher' Certificate of Achievement section (catalog pp. 89-90, Major Units: 28); the page also prints Associate Teacher, Master Teacher, Site Supervisor and other certificates.
Catalog prints codes with leading zeros (CH DEV 001, 002, 007, etc.); these were matched to closed-list codes CH DEV 1, 2, 7, 10, 22, 34, 42 and not flagged as additions.
CH DEV 011 (Child, Family, and Community, 3 units) is required in the catalog but absent from the closed list; recorded as a catalog addition.
The 16 general education units mentioned are for the California Child Development Permit: Teacher level, not part of the certificate's 28 units; no GE pattern or degree total recorded.
Outcome 2 prints 'culturally sen -sitive' split across a line with a PDF hyphenation break; recorded as 'sensitive'. Reviewer may verify.
The section describes teaching in private or public preschool and school-age programs but names no specific job title or career field beyond permit levels; careers left empty.
